### ♟️ *Chess Simplified: Foundations & Modern Chess Theory*

A structured introduction to chess fundamentals, bridging classical principles with modern strategic thinking. Designed for beginners and intermediate players looking to build a strong foundation while developing deeper positional understanding.

### 📊 *STAT 133 Course Reader (In Progress)*  
**Computational Statistics with Applications to Machine Learning**

Currently developing a course reader focused on practical statistical computing, bridging core statistical concepts with real-world applications in machine learning. Emphasis on intuition, implementation, and applied problem-solving.

<div class="subtle">
Planned topics include data manipulation, simulation, modeling, and applied statistical learning techniques.
